acceptance: Dry-run DDL for a default native Spark run matches what the adapter actually executes for Parquet.
Delta and Iceberg table formats still use their generators.
Registry and generator agree for spark (covered by the capability drift test).
context: Defect found during the Spark tuning review (2026-09-30) via Opus review Consideration on ddl_generator.py:812. Separate from, and not blocking, the Spark tuning items; spark-tuning-discovery-cli notes the interim mismatch.
description: benchbox/core/tuning/ddl_generator.py ~L812 maps "spark" to DeltaDDLGenerator, but native Spark defaults to Parquet (spark.py table_format default "parquet"). Dry-run DDL preview (core/dryrun.py ~L1047-1054 via get_ddl_generator) therefore renders Delta DDL for a default Parquet Spark run, and the capability registry (once spark has a row) would disagree with the generator. Also: constraint DDL is stripped only for Parquet/ORC; Delta and Iceberg use strip_v1_constraints=False (spark.py ~L638-647), so any registry note about constraints must be table-format aware. Decide generator selection by table_format (parquet/orc/delta/iceberg) rather than by platform name, keeping databricks and delta mapped as now.
